title: First principles design and band engineering of type-II As2C3/Sc2CF2 van der Waals heterostructure
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,788-796
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07652H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Xuan Sang, Nguyen Q. Cuong, Le Phuong Long
In this work, we systematically investigate the structural, electronic, mechanical, thermal, and optical properties of a two-dimensional (2D) As2C3/Sc2CF2 van der Waals (vdW) heterostructure using first-principles calculations.
